items.description:
House of Lipstick is a cosmetics and beauty retailer in Lansdowne that trades both online and from its shop on Haywood Road. The range covers makeup, including eyeshadow and contour palettes, foundation, lip products, mascara, primers and setting spray, together with brush sets for applying them. Beyond makeup the shop stocks perfume, skincare, handbags and accessories such as acrylic cosmetic organisers.

Orders placed on the website are shipped by courier to addresses across South Africa, and the shipping, returns and refunds terms are published online for customers to read before buying. The business suits shoppers who want makeup, fragrance and beauty accessories from one retailer, whether they shop online or in person. The store is in Lansdowne, Cape Town.

Hout Bay Dental Studio is a general and family dental practice on Victoria Avenue in Hout Bay, Cape Town, and has been caring for patients for over 40 years. Its services cover general, aesthetic and restorative dentistry, with comprehensive dental care for the whole family. The practice takes a holistic, minimally invasive approach that aims to combine long-term oral health with natural-looking results.

Clinicians work in English, Afrikaans, Dutch and German, and the practice welcomes patients from Cape Town and further afield. Its stated focus is evidence-based care and restorations that last. Prospective patients can book a consultation through the practice website. The studio is a good fit for families and for anyone looking for a dentist in the Hout Bay area.

Intercare Panorama is a medical centre in Panorama Healthcare Centre on Rothschild Boulevard, part of the wider Intercare group of medical facilities. Its services, as set out on the group facility page, include general practitioner consultations, pathology, minor surgery, vaccinations, aviation medicals and a diabetic clinic.

The facility is cashless, so patients should plan to pay by card, as card is the only payment method accepted there. Intercare says its facilities offer longer hours on weekdays and are open on weekends and public holidays, which makes the centre useful for people who cannot easily visit during standard office hours. The centre serves residents of Panorama and the surrounding area who want a GP and diagnostic services close to home.

Kasu's Interiors is a family-run interior decorating business at 42 Brockhurst Road in Kenwyn, established in 1998. The firm handles interior decorating for residential and corporate projects, and its listed services also cover curtain manufacturing, blinds, upholstery, headboards, ottomans and rods and tracks.

Its Houzz profile lists the Western Cape as the service area and shows completed projects in suburbs including Constantia and Kenilworth, with project titles such as a silk makeover and a French living room that show the range of styles it works in. One decorator can take on the window treatments, upholstered pieces and headboards for a whole room, which suits homeowners who want the work finished by a single firm. The studio is in Kenwyn, Cape Town.

Lacoste is a French sportswear and fashion store on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront, in the Quays District. The brand has been defining its style since 1933 and is known for its crocodile emblem and classic polo shirts. The store stocks clothing, footwear and accessories that blend sporty heritage with refined French design.

The store is at Shop 6205 and has parking at the Victoria Wharf parkade nearby. The Waterfront's store listing gives its trading hours as Monday to Sunday, 9am to 9pm. The store suits shoppers who want understated sportswear and visitors exploring the Waterfront.

Lekker Dite is a halaal restaurant on Dennegeur Avenue in Strandfontein, serving Cape Coloured cuisine alongside burgers, boerewors, pizzas and pizza pies. The restaurant is known for its Roti Gatsby and Village Chicken Burger, and its listing describes the roti gatsbys as the tastiest in town. The menu was developed by a qualified chef.

The business is a small, Muslim-owned restaurant that serves breakfast, lunch and casual meals, and it also offers catering. Its listing notes that it is child-friendly and that it sells fast food. Lekker Dite suits families and anyone in Strandfontein looking for halaal food with a Cape flavour.

Logica Beauty Supplies is a beauty industry supplier in Montigo Park, Montague Gardens, and sells only to qualified beauty professionals. Its range runs to more than 3,000 products, including oils, carrier and pre-blended oils, wax melts, body treatment base products and gels, hot stone therapy equipment, skincare and facial accessories. It also stocks furniture, lash, nail and waxing supplies, and a wellness line under the Logica Wellness name.

The website describes the business as one of the largest beauty suppliers, and its sales team is available to help customers choose products. Buyers can order online, collect in store or shop at the retail store on site. The supplier suits salons, spas and training academies that need professional stock in one place.

Mooi Hair Salon is a hair salon on Upper Orange Street in Oranjezicht, Cape Town, offering cuts, colour and styling for women and children. Its service list includes balayage, highlights, hair colouring, blow dries, curly hair treatments, keratin treatments, perms and straightening, hair extensions and weaves. The salon also offers a full grooming suite and nail services, according to the business listing.

Clients can book through the salon's Fresha listing, which shows its address and services. The range covers both colour and texture work, so the salon suits clients who want colour, styling and treatments handled in one appointment. It is a local option for residents of Oranjezicht and the surrounding Cape Town City Bowl.

Mr Cheap Transport is a removals company based in Killarney Gardens, Cape Town, established in 2008. It started with single-item furniture deliveries and grew into furniture, household and business removals. Its services include office removals, vehicle and motorbike transport, long-distance removals, packing, hoisting, dismantling and storage facilities.

The company has expanded into storage, vehicle hire and courier services, and runs routes across the country. It says it has served over 20,000 customers since it started, and its website lists a national call centre along with contact lines for the Western Cape, Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal. It says it keeps its prices as low as possible while improving its services. The business offers a free quote and suits homeowners, offices and companies that need goods moved within Cape Town or further afield.

Photo Booth World is a photo booth hire company based in Boston, Bellville, offering booths for events in Cape Town. It has been in operation since 2016 and provides several formats, including mirror booths, open booths, inflatable booths, glam booths, green screen booths, magazine-cover booths, 360-degree spin booths and roaming booths. The company also supplies a bus-style booth and a booth for in-store product activations.

Each booth uses quality cameras, printers and lighting, and the look can be customised with backdrops, templates, themed props and digital overlays to suit an event's theme. Booths use touch screens and produce instant prints for guests to take home. The service suits any event where guests want a photo to keep.

Salon Suzette is a laser, skin and nail clinic in Strand Pavilion on Beach Road in Strand, Cape Town. It offers CO2 laser skin resurfacing, laser skin treatments, laser hair removal, Environ facials and peels, Kalahari facials and chemical peels, skin needling, plasma pen treatments and skin tag removal. Manicures and pedicures are also on the menu.

The clinic has two treatment rooms and a team of five or more practitioners, according to its Fresha listing, which shows a 4.9 rating from more than 1,000 reviews. Clients can book online with instant confirmation. The clinic is adults only and wheelchair accessible, and it suits clients in Strand who want laser and skin treatments close to home.

Santa Ana Spur is a Spur Steak Ranches family restaurant in Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre at the V&A Waterfront. Its menu includes steaks, burgers, ribs and grills, and the restaurant is known for its harbour and Table Mountain views.

The restaurant is part of the Spur group, which runs its brands across South Africa and several other African countries. Guests can book a table online, or order for delivery or collection through the app and delivery partners listed on its page. It is open every day, from 9am until 9pm on weekdays and until 10pm on Fridays and Saturdays. The restaurant suits families and visitors to the Waterfront who want a sit-down meal with a view.

Sótano is a seafood and sushi restaurant on Beach Road in Mouille Point, Cape Town, open since 2012. It sits diagonally across from the Green Point Lighthouse, close to the V&A Waterfront, and its terrace has ocean views.

The menu blends Mediterranean-inspired dishes with fresh Cape seafood and crafted sushi, and the restaurant also serves signature cocktails and a selection of wines. Dishes include breakfasts, tapas, seafood linguine and paella. The owners travel to southern Europe each year for ideas, drawing on coastal cities such as Barcelona and San Sebastian for the menu. Sótano suits relaxed meals with an easy-going neighbourhood feel.

items.description:
Kiosk is a community space on Kloof Nek Road in Gardens that describes itself as a local hangout for coffee, crafts and conversation. Rather than a straightforward café, it is built around daily goods and a changing community programme, inviting visitors to stop in for a coffee, browse what is on offer that day, or get involved in community projects running out of the space.

The business frames itself as a gathering point for the Gardens neighbourhood, encouraging people to collaborate on projects rather than simply shop or eat and leave. Its own description calls for building something gritty and bright together, reflecting a focus on connection and creativity alongside the coffee counter. Kiosk sits on Kloof Nek Road at the foot of Signal Hill, convenient for residents of Gardens and nearby City Bowl suburbs.

items.description:
Ocean Basket at the V&A Waterfront is a Mediterranean-style seafood restaurant trading from Shop 222 on the Upper Level of Victoria Wharf Shopping Centre. The restaurant is set up as a bright, airy space with comfortable seating, and its own listing highlights sushi platters alongside the seafood menu, a family-friendly vibe and a steady stream of visitors exploring the Waterfront.

The space suits a range of occasions, from a quick lunch between shopping stops to a sit-down family dinner or a table booked for a special celebration. Trading hours run from midday through the afternoon and evening: Monday to Thursday it is open until 10pm, and on Friday and Saturday it stays open until 11pm. Being inside Victoria Wharf puts it a short walk from the harbour and the rest of the Waterfront's shops and restaurants.

items.description:
Rondebosch East Pharmacy operates inside Willowmead Medical Centre on Kromboom Road in Rondebosch East, dispensing prescription medicines and over-the-counter healthcare products alongside the centre's other practitioners. Willowmead describes itself as offering a comprehensive range of medical and paramedical services under one roof, with the pharmacy sitting alongside family practitioners, a dentist, physiotherapist, speech therapists, clinical psychologists, an occupational therapist, a baby clinic and beauty therapists in the same building.

That mix means a visit to the pharmacy can often be combined with seeing another practitioner in the same centre without travelling elsewhere. Willowmead describes its catchment as reaching beyond Rondebosch East itself to cover Claremont, Rondebosch, Crawford, Lansdowne, Athlone and Sybrand Park, so the pharmacy serves patients from across the southern suburbs who are already visiting the centre for other care, as well as walk-in customers needing medicines or health advice.

items.description:
Sterns trades from Shop 30 in the Golden Acre Shopping Centre on Adderley Street in Cape Town's CBD, as part of the national Sterns jewellery chain. The Golden Acre branch's own listing describes an exclusive range of diamond rings, bracelets and watches that can be customised to suit a particular occasion, drawing on more than 115 years of experience in the jewellery trade.

Being inside Golden Acre places the store in the middle of the Foreshore shopping precinct, within reach of the Cape Town railway station and the rest of the centre's retailers. Shoppers looking for an engagement ring, a watch or a gift piece can have it customised on site, backed by the long-standing diamond expertise the brand is built on.
